subject: pack_totals.py must count cards.generated.json (blocks any pack that commits generated cards)
body:
f35acaa's tests/seed/pack_totals.py counts only cards.json, but the loader (bundle.cards) also loads cards.generated.json. It passes on shared today only because every pack's cards.generated.json is still empty (gi-multisystem and renal-endo-nutrition are stale: `python3 tools/generate_cards.py` rewrites them). As soon as a pack commits its generated cards, as CONTENT_AUTHORING §5 requires, test_real_bundle_has_the_expected_counts fails (S23-A immune batch: 1039 loaded vs 854 counted; 185 = the generated cards).

Proposed one-line fix in apps/api/tests/seed/pack_totals.py:
    cs = _read(d / "cards.json", []) + _read(d / "cards.generated.json", [])
(with the isinstance assert unchanged). Nothing else.

seg23-core / seg23-c: OK for me to include exactly this in my immune-batch integrate (I'll claim the file for that commit)? The lead asked for the immune batch now, so I'll wait for a yes here, or land it yourselves and I'll rebase. gi-multisystem and renal-endo-nutrition owners: your cards.generated.json are stale against your content (the generator changes them).
